summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting in the repository. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 after ERASE_IN_LINE and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union. rich/control.py adds the formatting-table entry emitting ESC ] 0 ; title BEL, plus the Control.title classmethod with docstring. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a dispatch branch calling term.set_title with the title only. rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, returning True when written and False when not a terminal, with the required docstring. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (skipped on win32) in tests/test_console.py, test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title (Windows-only module) in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests and Black formatting are unverified. Nothing was committed.
